# DynDNS.org
> DynDNS provides dynamic DNS hostnames, DNS services, account management, billing, and service configuration for connected devices and domains.

This site centers on the My Dyn Account portal, where users manage DynDNS hosts, DNS zones, renewals, billing, preferences, and account settings for personal or small business use.

## Account Overview
- [My Dyn Account](https://www.dyndns.org/): Account login and overview for managing DynDNS services and settings.
- [Services Overview](https://www.dyndns.org/services/): Central dashboard for viewing and managing active DNS-related services.
- [Settings Overview](https://www.dyndns.org/profile/): Main account settings area for profile and service administration.
- [Billing Overview](https://www.dyndns.org/billing/): Billing dashboard for payments, renewals, and service-related charges.

## Dynamic DNS
- [DynDNS Hosts](https://www.dyndns.org/dns/dyndns/): Manage dynamic DNS hostnames for devices with changing IP addresses.
- [DynDNS Tips](https://www.dyndns.org/getstarted/): Getting started guidance for creating and using DynDNS hostnames.
- [Services Overview](https://www.dyndns.org/services/): Review Dynamic DNS services and related account resources.
- [Renew Services](https://www.dyndns.org/renew/?nav=services): Renew active Dynamic DNS and related subscription services.

## DNS Zones and Domains
- [Zones](https://www.dyndns.org/services/zones/): Manage DNS zones for your own domain and standard DNS hosting.
- [Services Overview](https://www.dyndns.org/services/): Access domain and DNS service management from the main services area.
- [DynDNS Hosts](https://www.dyndns.org/dns/dyndns/): Configure hostname-based DNS for dynamic IP-connected devices.
- [DynDNS Tips](https://www.dyndns.org/getstarted/): Learn setup basics for hostnames and DNS service usage.

## Renewals and Service Lifecycle
- [Renew Services](https://www.dyndns.org/renew/?nav=services): Renew services from the services management workflow.
- [Renew Services](https://www.dyndns.org/renew/?nav=billing): Renew services from the billing management workflow.
- [Auto Renew Settings](https://www.dyndns.org/autorenew/?nav=services): Configure automatic renewal preferences from the services section.
- [Auto Renew Settings](https://www.dyndns.org/autorenew/?nav=billing): Configure automatic renewal preferences from the billing section.
- [Active Services](https://www.dyndns.org/billing/services/): View currently active services associated with your account.

## Profile and Preferences
- [Settings Overview](https://www.dyndns.org/profile/): Access profile management and account configuration options.
- [Edit Preferences](https://www.dyndns.org/profile/prefs.html): Update account preferences and personal settings.
- [Move Services](https://www.dyndns.org/profile/moveservices.html): Transfer or reorganize services within your account.
- [Close Account](https://www.dyndns.org/profile/close.html): Begin the process of closing your DynDNS account.

## Billing and Payments
- [Billing Overview](https://www.dyndns.org/billing/): Review billing status, charges, and payment-related options.
- [Order History](https://www.dyndns.org/billing/history/): View past orders and billing transaction records.
- [Payment Methods](https://www.dyndns.org/billing/profile.html): Manage saved payment methods and billing profile details.
- [Active Services](https://www.dyndns.org/billing/services/): See billable services currently active on the account.
- [Renew Services](https://www.dyndns.org/renew/?nav=billing): Renew services directly from the billing section.

## Service Administration
- [Services Overview](https://www.dyndns.org/services/): Starting point for administering DNS and DynDNS services.
- [DynDNS Hosts](https://www.dyndns.org/dns/dyndns/): Configure and maintain hostname mappings for dynamic IP endpoints.
- [Zones](https://www.dyndns.org/services/zones/): Administer DNS zones for owned domains.
- [Move Services](https://www.dyndns.org/profile/moveservices.html): Reassign or move services between account contexts.
- [Active Services](https://www.dyndns.org/billing/services/): Cross-check active subscriptions and managed services.

## Support and Onboarding
- [DynDNS Tips](https://www.dyndns.org/getstarted/): Introductory setup help for new DynDNS users.
- [My Dyn Account](https://www.dyndns.org/): Entry point for account access and service overview.
- [Services Overview](https://www.dyndns.org/services/): Navigate to managed services after signing in.
- [Settings Overview](https://www.dyndns.org/profile/): Find account controls and configuration options.
